description: Supersedes cutover-record-corrections-and-quiescence-probe (dropped only to attach a falsifiable ladder; ladders are create-time-only). Two create-time-only defects in the tracked record of the 0.3 cutover, both confirmed by execution on 2026-08-01. (1) migrate-hosted-tracker-db-to-todo-db-0-3-schema still carries the must-preserve 'the hosted DB is never restored with --replace while another actor holds a live claim'. SUPERSEDED - a claim check is not a gate, because create/defer/promote/block/drop and config writes take no claim at all (root@vm emitted 21 unclaimed create/drop events in under 4 minutes on 2026-08-01). The block reason says so; the must-preserve row still says the wrong thing. That item has 5 dependents whose dep edges are create-time-only, so drop+recreate cascades into re-creating all five - do NOT drop it without an explicit ruling from Joe. Note scope-update now exists and fixes scope globs in place, but it does NOT cover preserves, so it does not help here. (2) Rung 1 of tracker-cutover-needs-a-write-freeze-not-a-claim-check shells out to 'todo stats --json', which does not exist; both reads capture empty stdout and '' == '' passes the rung UNCONDITIONALLY. Executed verbatim against production it exited 0 ('no writer is active') while the event count moved 4534 to 4538 during the very 60s window it was measuring. ADR decision D8 supersedes that rung rather than editing it; D7 records that todo-db 0.3's update verb cannot repair v4 records (SCHEMA_VERSION=5, refuses, fails safe). Decisions and runbook: _project/decisions/todo-db-cutover-write-freeze-2026-08-01.md
